501:
Displays the state of a remote lpd queue.

Usage: lpq  -Sserver -Pprinter [-l]

Options:
      -S server    Name or ipaddress of the host providing lpd service
      -P printer   Name of the print queue
      -l           verbose output
502: Error: Must specify server name or ipaddress.
506: Error: Printer %1 does not exist on %2.
509: Error: LPQ failed to initialize properly.
